## Sheriff

Across The Frontier, prospectors do the hard work
of building and maintaining pipelines that pan and 
process data to and from the Gold Mine. The `sheriff` is a simple 
package that provides a set of tools for enforcing the rules
and ensuring that users are a part of The Frontier and working
in a valid space.

To get the sheriff to inspect your papers, you can run the following command in your terminal:

```bash
# install uv
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

# install sheriff
uv tool install git+https://github.com/GoldenPlanetaryHealthLab/sheriff.git@v0.1.0
```
